flags.quotedSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.paragraph: Your initial membership term is twelve (12) months, beginning on the Commencement Date shown on your enrolment form. At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate. To stop a renewal you must deliver written notice of cancellation to the Member Services desk no later than three (3) days before the renewal date. Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full. A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.

flags.documentTitle: MERIDIAN ATHLETIC CLUB — MEMBER SERVICES AND INSTRUCTOR CERTIFICATION AGREEMENT
flags.quotedSentence: Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion.
flags.paragraph: Enrolment in the Meridian Instructor Certiﬁcation Program (the “Program”) is optional, is separate from membership, and is open to members in good standing. Tuition is billed annually in advance at the rate shown on your Program enrolment form and covers coursework, two practical assessments and one re-sit. Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion. Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition. You may end your Program enrolment by notifying the Program ofﬁce in writing at least ninety (90) days before the anniversary date, in which case no further tuition is charged and your candidacy closes at the end of the Program year then running. Program materials, the curriculum outline, the assessment rubrics and the Meridian coaching manual are conﬁdential and remain Meridian’s property.
